scenes.title: Lulu Lamb's Sleepy Animal Stretches
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Lulu Lamb's Sleepy Animal Stretches.
It was almost bedtime. The moon peeked in the window, and the stars began to twinkle.
But Honey Bunny was still hopping! Hop, hop, hop!
Mama, my legs are so wiggly! I can't stop hopping!
You had a busy, happy day, little one. Now your body needs help to slow down.
What do you think helps a wiggly body feel calm? Hmm?
A slow, sleepy stretch! And look who came to help.
Lulu Lamb and Mimi Kitten were visiting with their mamas, who were having tea in the kitchen.
Baa! Hello, Honey! We know the best sleepy stretches!
Animal stretches! Meow! Do you want to try?
Yes, please!
Everybody, find a soft mat. Pink, green, or blue. Which color mat would you pick?
I pick the green one! I'm ready!
First, the kitty stretch! Get on your hands and knees, like a kitty cat.
Now push your back up high, like a round, round hill. Up, up, up.
Then let your tummy sink down slowly, and look up at the stars.
Up like a hill, and down like a bowl! That feels nice!
Let's do it three times. One. Two. Three.
Can you make a kitty sound? What does a kitten say?
Meow! Soft and sleepy. Meow.
My turn! This one is called the sleepy sheep.
Sit back on your heels, and curl up small, like a soft, woolly ball.
Rest your head down. Now rock gently. Side to side. Side to side.
I'm a tiny, fluffy cloud!
Can you curl up small, like a sleepy sheep? Let's try together.
Baa. So cosy.
Hoo-hoo!
Who says hoo-hoo, at the window? Can you guess?
It's me, Ollie Owl! Good evening, friends! May I show you my owl stretch?
Open your arms wide, like big owl wings. Flap them slowly. Flap, and flap.
Now turn your head gently. This way, and that way. Owls look all around.
Slow wings make me feel so calm.
Now I have one! It's the bunny breath!
Bunnies sniff, sniff, sniff with their little noses. Then one long breath out. Ahh.
Let's do it together. Sniff, sniff, sniff. And blow out slowly. Ahh.
How many sniffs did we do? Can you count them?
Three sniffs! One, two, three!
My body feels soft and slow now.
The moon smiled down, and the friends sang a sleepy stretch song.
Stretch up high, touch the sky. Wave hello to the moon so bright!
Kitty arch, and sheep curl small.
Owl wings flap, and that is all!
Can you reach up high with us? Stretch, stretch, stretch!
Stretch up high, touch the sky. Goodnight, goodnight, sleep tight!
What a lovely, sleepy song. Goodnight, little stretchers.
Then Lulu and Mimi waved goodbye, and went home with their mamas.
How does your body feel now, Honey?
Not wiggly anymore. Just sleepy.
Which stretch did you like best? The kitty, the sheep, the owl, or the bunny?
I liked them all!
Let's take one more bunny breath. Sniff, sniff, sniff. And ahh.
And Honey Bunny drifted off to sleep, cosy and calm.
When your body feels wiggly, try a sleepy animal stretch, and a slow, soft breath.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Goodnight, little one. Sweet dreams, and see you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.
